description: This Java class provides utility functions for calculating and diagnosing shuffle checksum issues in Apache Spark, including checksum creation, retrieval, file naming, and corruption diagnosis.

classes.name: ShuffleChecksumHelper
classes.description: A utility class for creating, retrieving, and diagnosing shuffle checksum data in Spark.

methods.name: createPartitionChecksums
methods.description: Creates checksum objects for each partition based on the specified algorithm.

methods.name: getChecksumsByAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns an array of checksum objects corresponding to the specified algorithm.

methods.name: getChecksumByAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns a single checksum object for the specified algorithm.

methods.name: getChecksumFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the checksum file based on block name and algorithm.

methods.name: readChecksumByReduceId
methods.description: Reads the checksum value for a specific reduce ID from a checksum file.

methods.name: calculateChecksumForPartition
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for a given partition data buffer.

methods.name: diagnoseCorruption
methods.description: Diagnoses the cause of shuffle data corruption by comparing checksums.
